source_depth_risk.summary: Runtime attachment can preserve source refs and defer safely, but it does not yet know how to obtain run-specific safe brief, enriched brief, and triage inputs without manual fixture-style paths or future bounded interpretation.

user_surface_read.strength: Available, blocked, deferred, failed-closed, and agent-only states are visible with a non-claim line.
user_surface_read.limit: When safe brief inputs are absent, the receipt is mostly a deferred status rather than a useful decision-work summary. Available receipts can also fall back to generic action-consequence wording.

agent_handoff_read.strength: The handoff packet carries attachment status, brief refs, triage refs, source status, missingness, uncertainty placeholders, route outputs, and explicit non-claims.
agent_handoff_read.limit: The packet becomes much less useful when the runtime hook only creates a deferred sidecar with no run-specific brief or triage read.

blocker_gate_read.strength: Hard blockers, deferred reasons, and agent-only soft triage blockers are represented as states rather than hidden failures.
blocker_gate_read.limit: The gate can only classify status fields and explicit triage artifacts; it cannot determine messy semantic adequacy or advice correctness.

runtime_hook_read.summary: The hook can write a decision_work sidecar after archive completion, but a clean run without safe prebuilt brief and triage artifacts normally becomes deferred.

strongest_useful_signal: PR160-PR167 create a real runtime hinge: archive completion can optionally write a default-off, post-archive Decision Work sidecar with explicit status, receipt, and agent handoff without blocking the revised answer.
strongest_unresolved_risk: The runtime hook is still supply-limited: it cannot yet produce a useful run-specific Decision Work Brief, enriched brief, or triage read unless safe artifacts are supplied from outside the hook.
overclaim_risk: Because a sidecar now exists in runtime code, readers may overread mechanical attachment as product usefulness. PR168 keeps the distinction explicit: attached does not mean customer-ready, validated, correct, or default-on.

options_considered.finding: Useful later for receipt wording, but it would not solve the current input-supply gap.
